text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing sustained memory growth on prod inference hosts for long-chat sessions. KV page resident set keeps growing across session boundaries, looks like stale blocks are being reused instead of evicted. cc @sanjay @oliver :eyes:

maria: Logs snippet (prod dd-prod-01):
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:11Z] kvpage: insert tag=0x2a offset=0x1000 len=64 owner=req=abcd1234 token_idx=1024
[2026-03-15T14:22:12Z] kvpage: evict tag=0x2a offset=0x1000 tombstone=true
[2026-03-15T14:24:03Z] kvpage: lookup tag=0x2a offset=0x1000 for req=efgh5678 -> HIT (reused) token_idx=1008
[2026-03-15T14:24:03Z] kvpage: warning token_alignment_mismatch expected=1024 found=1008
```

maria: Repro pattern: long context (~50k tokens), then new chat started on same connection. After ~10 sessions we see ~20MB of leaked KV pages.

sanjay: Can you paste full request ids + model + quantization profile? want to trace kernel/path (maybe q4 kernel selection).

maria: Model=redwood-13b-q4, kernel-path=fastatten/q4v2, req root=abcd1234, followup=efgh5678. I attached a tiny repro harness (ran on canary pod). Output:
```
# kv table dump (shortened)
0x1000 -> { tag:0x2a, offset:0x1000, len:64, owner_req:abcd1234, last_used_token:1024 }
lookup by efgh5678 -> returned same entry, last_used_token still 1024 but returned token_idx=1008 (mismatch)
```

oliver: This looks like two issues colliding: tombstone not preventing reuse, and a stale token index being handed to the caller (off-by-one/offset). Could be slab rotation + async eviction race. Did we change batching heuristics or prefetch recently?

maria: Small config delta last week: batching.window_ms reduced from 6->4 and enabled prefetch=true for long contexts. Might affect ordering of eviction callbacks.

kate: I reproduced locally with stress harness (1000 short sessions + periodic long session). Stale_block counter increases when eviction callback path returns success but the slab metadata misses clearing owner_req. Quick debug assert I added: `assert(kv->owner_req == current_req_id || !kv->owner_req)` triggered twice.

kate: Proposed debug-only mitigation: when loading KV entry, validate owner_req == current_req_id (or stale) and if mismatch skip using that entry and increment a metric `kv.stale_skip`. I'll send a tiny canary patch.

maria: Deploying that mitigation to canary now (dd-prod-01, 1 pod). Will monitor mem/kv.stale_skip. If it drops memory growth and increases stale_skip, we know reuse is root cause.

ci-bot: deploy started: canary dd-prod-01 user=maria sha=3a7f6de status=running

sanjay: Opening proper fix PR — ensure eviction writes tombstone + increments generation counter so lookups check generation. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2345 (assert+generation bump + unit test). Leaving the mitigation in prod until PR merged. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — logs already show stale_skip=18 after 10m, memory flattened. Will keep monitoring and collect profile for root cause. If anyone has a reproducer harness improvements ping me and I'll add to eng-runtime repro suite.
